fee_notes: Current fee is $50,000, uniform and non-refundable. During 2025, fee ranged from $30,000 to $50,000.
raw_excerpt: The "Initial Franchise Fee" for a single Los Campeones business is $50,000. You must pay the Initial Franchise Fee to us when you sign the Franchise Agreement and it is not refundable under any circumstances. The Initial Franchise Fee we charge is uniform. During 2025, our Initial Franchise Fee ranged from $30,000 to $50,000.
